0022600217.text: The Washington Wizards (4-7, 2-5 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Indiana Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, on a two-game losing streak) for the Wizards' 12th game of the 2026-27 season. The teams have not met yet this season, and Washington won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on February 20, 2026. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell is day-to-day with a hamstring issue.
